name: DeepClef
description:
MINECRAFT AI AGENT
Don't Just Automate. Think.

An AI-powered Minecraft agent built upon AltoClef, capable of perceiving its surroundings, making decisions, and adapting its actions in real time.

Powered by DeepSeek, DeepClef combines environmental awareness with autonomous planning and execution. Explore, gather resources, craft and upgrade equipment, fight, ride, sail across water and ice, and fly with elytra through natural-language instructions.

In multiplayer, DeepClef can observe player chat, respond to teammates, and adapt its ongoing plan while coordinating actions and conversation.
